title: Concept: Contract destruction call present in solidity — review required
description: In solidity, the contract can destroy itself. Destruction is irreversible, sends the remaining balance to the address the caller chose, and makes every stored state unreachable. Guard mistakes in this path are usually permanent and financially final.
applicability: solidity contracts that hold value or durable state.
risk: Permanent loss of contract functionality and funds; MEDIUM severity.
